snippet.title: Quadphos - Trailer
snippet.description:
Quadphos is a rule-guessing logic puzzle game where you deduce the rules corresponding to each numerical clue and light up the grid to satisfy all the rules.
If you're interested in Quadphos, please add it to your Steam wishlist. A demo will be available soon.
